papers.title: Explainable machine learning for spatial modelling of groundwater nitrate contamination: a multi-year analysis in the Duero basin
papers.journal: International Journal of River Basin Management
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 machine learning、explainable、shap、precipitation、hydrolog，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Groundwater nitrate contamination is a major water-quality concern, with implications for drinking water supplies and groundwater-dependent ecosystems. This study assesses the Duero River basin (Spain), where groundwater nitrate concentrations have increased in recent decades due to intensive agriculture and livestock farming. The probability of elevated groundwater nitrate concentrations was predicted using machine learning, formulated as a binary classification problem with a threshold of 37.5 mg/L. Monitoring data were combined with spatially derived environmental and anthropogenic predictors. Several tree-based algorithms were evaluated, with Random Forest selected for its consistent predictive performance. Model performance was assessed through repeated nested cross-validation and the use of metrics suitable for imbalanced datasets, achieving an AUC of 0.79-0.88 and an F1-score of 0.56-0.70 for the minority class across the three analysed hydrological years. SHAP analysis identified precipitation, diffuse agricultural pressures, distance to surface water bodies, NDVI, and soil properties as the main contributing predictors. Multi-year probability maps showed substantial spatial coherence with officially designated Nitrate Vulnerable Zones (46.9-64.9%), while identifying additional high-probability areas outside them (12.7-23.6%). The integration of explainable machine learning, multi-year spatial modelling, and regulatory comparison provides a framework to support groundwater monitoring, review vulnerable-zone delineation, and prioritise mitigation measures.

papers.title: Diagnosing region-specific flood influencing factors in a volcanic island using explainable machine learning
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 machine learning、explainable、hydrolog、rainfall，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract This study applies a grid-based, explainable machine learning framework to identify dominant flood-influencing factors under hydrologically heterogeneous conditions, using Jeju Island as a representative volcanic environment. Historical flood trace maps were integrated with multi-layer spatial datasets to classify flooded and non-flooded grid cells at a 100 m resolution using five tree-based algorithms. The models achieved recall and F1-scores of up to 0.86 and 0.78, respectively. Feature-importance and explainability analyses demonstrate that the dominance of flood-influencing factors varies across spatial contexts, with hydrometeorological conditions acting as the primary drivers and spatial exposure and proximity-based factors contributing in a region-specific manner. The results highlight diagnostic insights into the primary drivers of flooding and suggest that factors which may be underrepresented in conventional rainfall-centric assessments can exert substantial influences on flood occurrence.

papers.title: Long-term changes and attribution of lake water levels on the Tibetan Plateau revealed by multisource satellite altimetry data
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、plateau、climate、precipitation，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: ABSTRACT Monitoring Tibetan Plateau (TP) lakes is constrained by harsh environments and methodological limitations. To overcome the limited spatiotemporal coverage of single-mission satellite altimetry and the shortcomings of conventional linear analyses, we integrated CryoSat-2 and Sentinel-3A/B altimetry observations with a multilevel robust anomaly-detection framework to generate water-level time series for 11 representative TP lakes (2010–2026). Seasonal-Trend Decomposition using LOESS (STL) and an XGBoost–SHapley Additive exPlanations(SHAP) framework was subsequently employed to characterize spatiotemporal variations and assess nonlinear associations with five hydrometeorological factors. The generated time series showed strong agreement with in-situ observations (R > 0.94, RMSE: 0.07–0.11 m). Over the 16-year study period, more than 80% of the investigated lakes exhibited sustained water-level increases, with a regional mean rate of 0.27 m yr -1 . However, lake trajectories recent lake trajectories diverged, with some showing accelerated rises and others displaying decelerating or reversed trends. Intra-annual variability also intensified: the mean seasonal amplitude increased by 48.6% (0.17 m) during the last five years. Attribution analysis revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity. While statistical modeling indicated that precipitation (32.5%) and groundwater (21.6%) made the largest regional contributions within the XGBoost framework, individual lakes exhibited predominantly precipitation-dominated, thermal-loss-sensitive, or groundwater-associated response patterns. These contrasting patterns are likely modulated by differences in basin topography, lake morphology, and local geological settings. These findings provide an improved basis for estimating lake-water-storage changes, assessing long-term water-level trends, monitoring overflow and flood hazards, and investigating interactions among lake ecosystems, climate variability, and regional water resources across the TP.

papers.title: Physics vs. AI in weather prediction: evaluating GraphCast, AIFS, and FuXi against an observation-corrected WRF model for flash floods
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 artificial intelligence、precipitation、temperature、weather，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract. Data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) weather models are increasingly positioned as alternatives or complements to physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems, yet systematic model evaluation studies that compare both paradigms under controlled experimental conditions remain limited. Here we present a structured model evaluation framework applying standardised verification metrics to assess a regional WRF configuration against three publicly available AI models – GraphCast, AIFS Single 1.0, and FuXi – over three high-impact flood events in Luxembourg and the Greater Region (2016, 2018, and 2021), comprising 90 simulation days and over 7300 matched forecast-observation pairs. The WRF model employs a three-dimensional variational (3D-VAR) data assimilation scheme ingesting GNSS Zenith Total Delay and conventional observations on a 6-hourly Rapid Update Cycle. All systems are initialised from ERA5 reanalysis to ensure consistent initial conditions. Categorical precipitation scores at the 1 mm threshold and continuous temperature metrics at surface stations serve as verification targets. Data assimilation measurably improves WRF's categorical precipitation skill (Critical Success Index: 0.306 to 0.341) while leaving near-surface temperature largely unchanged, demonstrating the value of the assimilation scheme. AIFS achieves the highest detection rate (POD 0.765) and net categorical skill (CSI 0.370), GraphCast and AIFS reduce temperature RMSE by ~10 % relative to assimilated WRF, and WRF alone reproduces the observed mesoscale precipitation structure of the catastrophic July 2021 flood. The per-event breakdown reveals no skill degradation for AI models on out-of-sample events, suggesting that meteorological regime rather than training-data overlap governs model performance. These results provide a replicable model evaluation methodology for benchmarking emerging data-driven NWP systems against observation-corrected regional models.

papers.title: Cloud vertical structure across China from a national Ka-band cloud radar network: thermodynamic, dynamical, and land-surface controls
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、plateau、climate、hydrolog、weather，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract. Cloud vertical structure plays a central role in regulating Earth’s radiation balance and hydrological cycle, yet it remains poorly represented in weather and climate models due to limited high-resolution observations. Using a newly established national network of 80 Ka-band cloud radars, we provide the first high-spatiotemporal-resolution characterization of cloud vertical structure across China for 2024 and quantify its thermodynamic, dynamical, and land-surface controls. An improved retrieval algorithm accounting for height-dependent radar sensitivity and clutter suppression is applied to derive cloud boundaries. The national annual mean cloud occurrence frequency is 56.7 %, dominated by single-layer clouds (34.7 %), followed by two-layer (14.7 %) and multi-layer clouds (7.1 %). Single-layer clouds prevail over arid northwestern China, whereas multi-layer clouds are more frequent in humid southeastern regions. Cloud base height exhibits strong seasonality, with higher values in summer and lower values in winter, and distinctly lower bases over the Tibetan Plateau. Diurnally, summer clouds show a pronounced afternoon peak between 3 and 9 km, while winter clouds are mainly confined below 3 km with a near-sunrise maximum. Thermodynamic conditions exert primary control on cloud vertical development. Higher low-level humidity favors deeper clouds and higher tops, whereas stronger lower-tropospheric stability suppresses vertical growth. Wind shear generally limits cloud depth, though moderate shear may enhance organization under unstable conditions. Land-surface characteristics further modulate cloud base height, with higher bases over barren land and lower bases over forests. These results provide national-scale observational benchmarks for improving cloud parameterizations in numerical models.

papers.title: Reconstructed Evapotranspiration in Northern China: Trends, Drivers, and Ecohydrological Impacts
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“东亚气候”：标题或摘要命中 precipitation、climate、atmospher、hydrolog，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: ABSTRACT Attributing regional evapotranspiration (ET) and assessing its impacts are critical for understanding land‐atmosphere interactions in climate‐sensitive regions such as northern China. This study fuses six gridded ET products with in situ measurements using Random Forest after excluding poorly representative flux sites. The resulting monthly 0.25° dataset (1980 to 2021) outperforms all original products, reducing the cross‐validation RMSE from 15.15–22.03 mm month −1 to 11.54 mm month −1 . Based on reconstructed ET, significant increasing ET trends ( p < 0.05) are observed on the Loess Plateau and North China Plain, with a mean trend of 13.3 mm (10a) −1 in humid regions. Using XGBoost with SHAP analysis reveals that precipitation dominates ET interannual variability in grasslands and bare lands, accounting for 35.4% to 40.6%. Yet, as a driver of the long‐term ET trend, precipitation is dominant only in about 5% of the region, specifically over bare land in western Inner Mongolia. Instead, NDVI drives ET trends over 52% of northern China, making vegetation greening a primary force enhancing ET under warming. Enhanced ET offsets precipitation‐driven water yield gains most markedly in semi‐arid regions. There, the ET‐induced reduction reaches −11.4 ± 7.7 mm (10a) −1 , exceeding the positive contribution from precipitation (2.3 ± 9.2 mm (10a) −1 ). Meanwhile, ET positively contributes to the Evaporative Stress Index (ET/PET) over semi‐arid regions, generating a coexistence of ecological wetting but hydrological drying. This study provides ecological insights into ET changes and their contrasting hydrological impacts in climate‐sensitive regions.

papers.title: Antarctic sea ice over the past 130 000 years – Part 2: A review of its role in the Earth system
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“极地气候”：标题或摘要命中 antarctic、sea ice、atmospher、ocean、circulation，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract. Antarctic sea-ice cover reached historically low levels in 2023, consistent with the simulated decrease in sea-ice extent in response to anthropogenic warming. Antarctic sea ice is closely linked to multiple components of the Earth system, thus its demise could precipitate widespread, cascading changes across the cryosphere, atmosphere, and ocean. However, the nature and strength of these interconnections are poorly understood, and they are often inadequately represented in models. In this review paper we use modern observations, models and paleoclimate archives covering the last glacial cycle to gain insights into how reductions in sea ice may affect other components of the Earth system. We review how Antarctic sea ice interacts with ocean and atmosphere circulation, ice sheets and ice shelves, marine productivity, and the carbon cycle over the last glacial cycle, for which we have the most robust sea-ice reconstructions. The review finds strong evidence from theory and models for impacts of Antarctic sea ice on the Earth system. Paleo-proxy reconstructions provide examples where changes in sea ice co-occur with changes in the carbon cycle, marine productivity, and ocean circulation. However, challenges remain in isolating the impact of sea ice in a highly interconnected system.

papers.title: ENSO's Imprint on the Southern Ocean: Wind Waves Drive Surface Cross‐Frontal Flow
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“极地气候”：标题或摘要命中 southern ocean、ocean、teleconnection，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract Tropical teleconnection associated with El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is widely recognized for regulating multiple physical processes in the Southern Ocean. However, despite its influence on Southern Ocean wind patterns, the response of surface flow has received little attention. Here, we investigate surface flow in the Southern Ocean using surface‐drifting buoy trajectories collected during September 2022–May 2023 and November 2023–June 2024. Drifter observations exhibit significant cross‐frontal movements primarily driven by Stokes drift rather than Ekman velocity. The observations also show interannual variability, with strong poleward cross‐frontal flow in 2024 during a strong El Niño event. Further analyses over the past approximately 31 years indicate that ENSO teleconnection is the primary driver of this interannual variability. These findings provide a new perspective on how tropical teleconnection influences cross‐frontal flow via wind waves and highlight their potential role in tracer transport across fronts.

papers.title: Predicting environmental health-related search patterns using freely available digital and reanalysis data: A critical evaluation of Google Trends and global datasets for Morocco
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 machine learning、climate、atmospher、temperature，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Climate change and environmental degradation increasingly threaten urban public health, yet monitoring infrastructure is often unavailable in resource-constrained settings. This study develops and critically evaluates a machine learning framework that predicts environmental health-related search behavior , used as a low-cost digital proxy rather than a measure of clinical burden, in Morocco using exclusively open-access global datasets. We integrated five years of weekly data (April 2020 to April 2025) from ERA5 meteorological reanalysis, Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service products, and Google Trends to model binary high-interest states for four search categories: air quality, respiratory conditions, heat-related illness, and allergies. Ensemble models with 71 engineered features achieved strong classification performance (ROC-AUC 0.92 to 0.96) with temporal stability over 52-week horizons. An ablation study showed that this discrimination is carried primarily by the autocorrelated search signal; the environmental reanalysis block added negligible incremental ROC-AUC at national scale, yet retained meaningful standalone signal for the respiratory and air-quality categories while collapsing to near-random for allergy and heat-related illness. This contrast tracks biological plausibility, which varied substantially across categories: respiratory predictions aligned with established epidemiological patterns, whereas heat-related predictions showed weak temperature correspondence and implausible winter peaks. We therefore frame the system as a complementary screening layer pending external validation against clinical endpoints, not as a validated disease-surveillance or operational warning system. Because it relies solely on freely available data, the framework offers a replicable national-scale prototype for environmental health monitoring across North Africa and the Global South, contributing to SDG 3, 11, and 13.

papers.title: Summertime ozone sensitivity to temperature in China: observational evidence and mechanistic attribution in urban and rural areas in the Yangtze River Delta region
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“东亚气候”：标题或摘要命中 yangtze、climate、temperature，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract. As climate change increases frequency and intensity of hot extremes, understanding how elevated temperatures influence surface ozone (O3) across different chemical regimes is critical. We combine observations from summer 2022 in the Yangtze River Delta (YRD) with targeted United Kingdom Chemistry and Aerosols (UKCA) Box experiments to quantify and attribute the temperature sensitivity of ground-level O3 in a VOC-limited urban megacity (Shanghai) and a predominantly NOx-limited rural region (Lishui). Observed daily-maximum O3 increases with temperature at both sites, with a stronger response in Shanghai. Two-dimensional T-RH distributions show that O3 rises with temperature and decreases with relative humidity (RH), implying that part of the temperature response is mediated by drying. Factorial box-model experiments separate the roles of temperature-driven shifts in chemical partitioning, diurnal thermal structure, temperature-dependent isoprene emissions, and humidity. In Shanghai, the increase in O3 between 30 °C and 40 °C is dominated by BVOC-driven chemistry, with temperature-amplified isoprene emissions explaining most of the observed response. In Lishui, O3 sensitivity is governed primarily by radical-NOx chemistry and thermal PAN-NOx cycling, with a much smaller role for BVOCs. Fixed RH scenarios substantially reduce the apparent contribution of “thermal chemistry”, highlighting humidity-dependent Ox loss and HOx-NOx cycling as key modifiers of the climate penalty. These regime-specific O3-temperature mechanisms, including BVOC-driven in the urban core, radical-NOx-PAN-driven in the rural area, and significant humidity modulation, provide a process basis for heat-resilient emission controls and demonstrate the value of observation-constrained box models as a bridge to regional chemistry-climate simulations.

papers.title: Explainable spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks: Multi-City PM2.5 forecasting in Bangladesh with geographic graph topology validation
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 explainable、atmospher，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Accurate forecasting of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is critical for mitigating severe health risks in South Asia, yet it remains challenging in data-scarce regions like Bangladesh. While spatiotemporal graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a promising solution by capturing atmospheric transport, their effectiveness and the physical validity of their assumed spatial graphs have rarely been rigorously tested in such constrained settings. This study addresses this gap by evaluating a graph diffusion gated recurrent unit (GD-GRU) model using four years of daily, multi-source environmental data across a 12-city network. For forecasts up to three days ahead, the GD-GRU achieves an overall mean absolute error of 8.853 µg/m3 and an R2 of 0.666, significantly outperforming non-graph baselines under FDR-corrected Diebold-Mariano testing (p < 0.001). Furthermore, the model significantly outperforms DCRNN when pooled across all forecast horizons (p < 0.001), while remaining closely matched at individual lead times. Crucially, empirical validation of the model's underlying spatial assumptions demonstrates that occlusion-based spatial influence closely tracks the fixed geographic adjacency (r = 0.928, p < 0.001), and this simple distance-based graph outperforms unconstrained adaptive, wind-informed, and hybrid alternatives. Finally, a multi-method explainability framework shows strong rank convergence (Spearman ρ = 0.590 to 0.783), identifying the Green Leaf Index, wind speed, atmospheric pressure, and seasonal encoding as the dominant predictors of PM2.5. These findings confirm that carefully validated, interpretable static graph models can deliver robust air quality forecasts without requiring dense sensor networks, offering a practical template for environmental monitoring in data-limited regions.

papers.title: A performance-based multivariable weighting framework for WRF parameterization-scheme selection
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“东亚气候”：标题或摘要命中 precipitation，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract. The selection of optimal physical parameterization schemes is a major source of uncertainty in WRF model simulations. A comprehensive evaluation of model performance requires simultaneous consideration of multiple output variables. However, existing multivariate approaches often rely on subjective or overly simplistic equal-weighting strategies and lack an objective mechanism to quantify variable importance. Such limitations can obscure significant biases in poorly simulated variables. To overcome this issue, this study proposes an objective dynamic weighting method for multivariate evaluation. The method employs a two-layer weighting framework based on two statistical metrics: the mean relative error, which measures the simulation accuracy of a variable, and the coefficient of variation of the absolute error, which reflects the sensitivity of a variable to the physical process under evaluation. The approach is applied and validated in assessing WRF parameterization schemes across two climatically distinct environments: the arid Northwest and the humid coastal Southeast of China. The results show that the method assigns greater weights to poorly simulated variables, such as precipitation and wind speed, thereby enabling the identification of more physically plausible and robust parameterization scheme combinations. Compared with the equal-weighting method, the scheme combinations obtained using this approach produce a lower Multivariate Integrated Evaluation Index (MIEI), a higher correlation coefficient (R), a lower Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and exhibit superior performance in independent extreme-year validations. By dynamically incorporating both simulation performance and sensitivity specific to each variable, the method offers a more rigorous and objective framework for model evaluation and uncertainty reduction.
